The code should apply the boundary conditions to the system of equations and print the shape of the matrix.

Finally, the code should solve the system of equations using the fast solver and print the time it took to solve the system. The code should also plot the original mesh.

a, __and__, matrix_A, a_u, get_code, assembly_for_sspace_and_vspace_with_vector_basis, ATriMesher, test_dirichlet_and_neumann_bc_on_interval_mesh, test_dirichlte_and_neumann_bc_on_tetrahedron_mesh, get_gauss_point_and_weight, get_quadrature_point_and_weight, apply_for_other_space, get_quadrature_points_and_weights, get_all_gauss_point_and_weight, LinearElasticityRLFEMFastSolver, LinearElasticityLFEMFastSolver, solve_linear_system_2, solve_linear_system_1, solve_linear_system_0, LinearElasticityHZFEMFastSolve

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from fealpy.mesh import TriangleMesh
from fealpy.functionspace import LagrangeFiniteElementSpace
from fealpy.boundarycondition import DirichletBC, NeumannBC
from fealpy.linear_system import solve_linear_system_0
from fealpy.tools.show import showmultirate
import time

class BoxDomain2D:
    def __init__(self, box=[0, 1, 0, 1], nx=10, ny=10):
        self.box = box
        self.nx = nx
        self.ny = ny
        self.mesh = self.create_mesh()
    
    def create_mesh(self):
        x0, x1, y0, y1 = self.box
        mesh = TriangleMesh.boxmesh2d([x0, x1, y0, y1], nx=self.nx, ny=self.ny)
        return mesh

    def displacement(self, p):
        # Example: linear displacement
        u = np.zeros((p.shape[1], 2), dtype=np.float64)
        u[:, 0] = p[0]
        u[:, 1] = p[1]
        return u

    def strain(self, p):
        # Example: constant strain
        return np.ones((p.shape[1], 3), dtype=np.float64)

    def stress(self, p):
        # Example: constant stress
        return np.ones((p.shape[1], 3), dtype=np.float64)

    def source(self, p):
        # Example: zero source
        return np.zeros((p.shape[1], 2), dtype=np.float64)

    def is_dirichlet_boundary(self, p):
        x0, x1, y0, y1 = self.box
        x, y = p
        return (np.isclose(x, x0) | np.isclose(x, x1) | np.isclose(y, y0) | np.isclose(y, y1))

    def is_neumann_boundary(self, p):
        # Example: no Neumann boundary
        return np.zeros(p.shape[1], dtype=bool)

    def is_fracture_boundary(self, p):
        # Example: no fracture
        return np.zeros(p.shape[1], dtype=bool)

class IterationCounter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.count = 0

    def __call__(self, rk=None):
        self.count += 1

class FastLinearElasticitySolver:
    def __init__(self, A, b, preconditioner=None):
        self.A = A
        self.b = b
        self.preconditioner = preconditioner

    def precondition(self, x):
        if self.preconditioner is not None:
            return self.preconditioner(x)
        return x

    def solve(self, tol=1e-8, maxiter=1000, callback=None):
        from scipy.sparse.linalg import cg
        x, info = cg(self.A, self.b, tol=tol, maxiter=maxiter, callback=callback, M=self.preconditioner)
        return x

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Initialize domain and mesh
    domain = BoxDomain2D(box=[0, 1, 0, 1], nx=20, ny=20)
    mesh = domain.mesh

    # Define Lagrange finite element space
    p = 1
    space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace(mesh, p=p, dim=2)

    # Dirichlet boundary condition
    def dirichlet_bc(p):
        return domain.is_dirichlet_boundary(p)

    bc = DirichletBC(space, domain.displacement, dirichlet_bc)

    # Neumann boundary condition (none in this example)
    def neumann_bc(p):
        return domain.is_neumann_boundary(p)

    nbc = NeumannBC(space, lambda p: np.zeros((p.shape[1], 2)), neumann_bc)

    # Solution function
    uh = space.function()

    # Assemble stiffness matrix and load vector
    from fealpy.fem import LinearElasticityModel2d
    model = LinearElasticityModel2d(E=1.0, nu=0.3)
    A = space.stiff_matrix(model.stiff_tensor)
    F = space.source_vector(domain.source)

    # Apply Neumann BC
    F += nbc.apply()

    # Apply Dirichlet BC
    bc.apply(A, F, uh)

    print("Matrix shape:", A.shape)

    # Solve system
    counter = IterationCounter()
    solver = FastLinearElasticitySolver(A, F)
    t0 = time.time()
    uh[:] = solver.solve(callback=counter)
    t1 = time.time()
    print(f"Solved in {t1 - t0:.4f} seconds, iterations: {counter.count}")

    # Plot mesh
    mesh.add_plot(plt)
    plt.title("Original Mesh")
    plt.show()
